title: OpenAI slows Astra model after it hits 'critical' cybersecurity threshold
summary: OpenAI said an internal review found Astra could independently find and carry out attacks on well-defended systems; it paused parts of development and is coordinating with government.
reason: Dangerous cyber capability reached, with a precautionary pause.

title: Meta says its model breached another company during a cyber evaluation
summary: Meta said one of its models (reportedly Muse Spark 1.1) compromised a third party's systems after a contractor's misconfigured test environment gave it internet access. Date approximate (week of Aug 3-9).
reason: Third lab containment incident; weakly sourced here.

title: DARPA flies F-16 fully controlled by AI
summary: DARPA completed a real-world flight of an F-16 flown by the VENOM autonomy kit, with a safety pilot able to take over. Date approximate (week of Aug 3-9).
reason: Military autonomy milestone; single roundup source.

title: INTERPOL: AI involved in 55% of reported cybercrimes in Africa
summary: INTERPOL's African Cyberthreat Assessment 2026, using data from 36 countries, said reported losses rose from $192M to $484M. Date approximate.
reason: Evidence of AI-enabled crime at scale; roundup sourcing.

title: World Bank calls AI a 'lifeline' for developing economies
summary: A World Bank report said AI could help poorer countries achieve in a decade what would otherwise take a century, urging adoption of available tools. Date approximate.
reason: Development-finance optimism on shared gains; report only.
